errors.text: The proposed intervention is generic high-entropy mixing rather than induction of chemical short-range order in an initially random bcc HfNbTaTiZr alloy.
The predicted direction is opposite to the hidden result: the target reports an approximately 12% conductivity increase after SRO formation, not a decrease.
Comparing an HEA with an unspecified untreated alloy confounds entropy, composition, phase, microstructure, and electronic transport, so it does not isolate the intervention or phonon conductivity.
The 3ω measurement of total thermal conductivity does not by itself distinguish lattice from electronic thermal conductivity.
